description: Machine-readable command catalog for vulcan. 58 tools across 13 groups.

groups.market: Market data: prices, orderbooks, candles, funding rates
groups.position: Position management: view, close, reduce, bracket orders
groups.margin: Collateral management: deposit, withdraw, transfer, leverage tiers
groups.history: Phoenix/Rise trader history: fills, orders, collateral, funding, PnL
groups.status: Health check, connectivity, and CLI update detection
groups.wallet: Wallet creation, address, listing, and balance
groups.portfolio: Combined portfolio snapshot in a single fetch
groups.paper: Local paper trading simulation with live prices and no real funds
groups.strategy: Curated Vulcan-owned strategy runners with tick logs and reports
groups.ta: Technical analysis: indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, BBands, ATR, VWAP, ADX, Stoch) and trigger evaluation over candle history

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_twap_start
commands.description: Run a Vulcan-owned market-order TWAP strategy with structured tick logs, lot-aware base-lot conversion, launch-time margin feasibility checks, a persisted slice ledger, and wallet context. Present modes as Paper mode, Live mode with confirmation required, Live mode with automatic execution, and Plan mode with dry run. Before launch, ask whether the user wants cross-margin or isolated-margin execution, plus additional triggers and safety guardrails such as TP/SL intent, max leverage/exposure, max total notional, max per-step notional, and drift limits. Paper, dry_run, live confirm_each, and live auto_execute are supported. Launch and monitoring contract for multi-tick MCP runs: see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs). TWAP-specific tick narration: every tick is a fill — lead with execution progress (planned vs executable slice, fill, cumulative VWAP) over equity, and report each slice with full transaction signature.

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_grid_start
commands.description: Run a Vulcan-owned grid strategy with structured tick logs, persisted level ledger, optional per-level TP/SL intent, paper/dry_run/live modes, launch-time margin feasibility checks, replacement maintenance, optional run-until-stopped lifecycle, stale-run detection, and local runner locking. Before launch, ask whether the user wants cross-margin or isolated-margin execution. Cross-margin live grids use multi-limit transactions; isolated live grids submit individual isolated limit orders and can transfer optional collateral on the first order. Live maintenance treats missing resting levels as filled and submits flipped replacement orders. TP/SL activation remains pending until fills can be mapped authoritatively. Launch and monitoring contract for multi-tick MCP runs: see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs). Grid-specific tick narration: most ticks are no-fill maintenance — send a concise heartbeat per tick (do not go silent). Report fills/replacements in compact tables with full transaction signatures. Per-level TP/SL is intent only until a bracket action is actually recorded. The runner is a local process, not a daemon — if lifecycle.stale=true the agent stops claiming the grid is maintained and tells the user to resume/reconcile. Use vulcan_strategy_finalize for explicit cleanup.

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_ta_start
commands.description: Run a TA-driven strategy whose behaviour is fully described by a JSON config of rules. Each rule pairs a boolean Condition over indicators/price/constants (`compare`, `crosses`, `all`/`any`/`not`) with an Action (`open` / `close` / `reduce` / `noop`). Each tick the runner: (1) reads pause/stop control, (2) snapshots market + position, (3) computes every distinct indicator referenced across the rule set exactly once, (4) walks rules top-down — the first one whose condition fires (and is not cooldown-locked or position-filter-skipped) dispatches its action and ends the tick. Cooldown policies: `none`, `until_condition_resets` (default), `once_per_run`, `min_ticks`. Reuses TWAP/grid scaffolding (run id, ledger, control IPC, pause/stop, monitor/status/wait_next_tick/report). Launch and monitoring contract for multi-tick MCP runs: see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs). TA-specific tick narration: report which rule fired (or 'no rule matched') per tick, plus the indicator values that drove the decision. Live modes require acknowledged=true plus --allow-dangerous.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: TA strategy config object: { symbol, interval_seconds, margin_mode?, isolated_collateral?, max_concurrent_position_tokens?, max_firings?, rules: [ { name, when, do, cooldown?, only_if_position? }, ... ] }. `when` is a Condition tree; `do` is an Action enum {kind: open|close|reduce|noop, ...}.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: paper | dry_run | confirm_each | auto_execute

parameters.description: Maximum ticks to run; ignored when run_until_stopped is true

parameters.description: Optional run label

parameters.name: detached
parameters.description: Return immediately with run_id; the agent enters the monitoring loop automatically (see CONTEXT.md § Strategy Monitoring (Detached Runs))

parameters.name: max_total_notional_usdc
parameters.description: Guardrail total live notional

parameters.name: max_step_notional_usdc
parameters.description: Guardrail per-firing notional

parameters.name: max_price_drift_bps
parameters.description: Guardrail price drift from launch

parameters.description: Guardrail position notional / equity

commands.description: Show compact latest status and ticks for a persisted strategy run. By default omits the full ledger to keep agent context small.

parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: since_tick
parameters.description: Return ticks newer than this tick index in new_ticks

parameters.name: include_ledger
parameters.description: Include the full persisted ledger; defaults to false to reduce context

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_monitor
commands.description: Return compact non-blocking monitor state for a strategy run: last observed tick, heartbeat age, expected next tick, runner lock, stale status, and event counts.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: include_ledger
parameters.description: Include the full persisted ledger; defaults to false to reduce context

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_reconcile_grid
commands.description: Read-only inspection of live grid orders against the persisted grid ledger. Reports expected resting levels and missing levels without mutating ledger state.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_wait_next_tick
commands.description: Wait server-side until a strategy emits a tick newer than after_tick, reaches a terminal status, or times out. Use this between detached MCP strategy ticks instead of shell sleep or repeated full status polls.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: after_tick
parameters.description: Return once a tick newer than this index exists. Defaults to current latest tick at call time.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait before returning current status with timed_out=true

parameters.name: include_ledger
parameters.description: Include the full persisted ledger; defaults to false to reduce context

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_report
commands.description: Read the final or latest persisted report for a strategy run.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_pause
commands.description: Request a running strategy to pause at the next safe point. Paused runs can be resumed.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional reason recorded in the ledger

commands.example: vulcan strategy pause twap-... --reason user_requested -o json

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_stop
commands.description: Request a running strategy to stop permanently at the next safe point.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional reason recorded in the ledger

commands.example: vulcan strategy stop twap-... --reason user_requested -o json

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_finalize
commands.description: Request strategy stop and optionally perform explicit cleanup: cancel open orders on the strategy symbol and/or close any open position. Cleanup flags require acknowledgement.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional reason recorded in the ledger

parameters.name: cancel_orders
parameters.description: Cancel open orders on the strategy symbol

parameters.name: close_position
parameters.description: Close any open position on the strategy symbol

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the runner to observe the stop request before cleanup

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait for runner progress

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Required when cleanup flags are true via MCP

commands.name: vulcan_strategy_resume
commands.description: Resume a paused or incomplete persisted strategy run.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Strategy run ID

parameters.name: from_step
parameters.description: Optional step index to resume from

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Required when resuming via MCP
